title: Man Looking for Revenge Gets Karma Instead
description:
Today’s case is about the failed revenge story of an ex-husband. Well, the officer's temper is justified since the man kept dialling 911 and claiming that his ex-wife was not treating his kids properly. However, a huge plot twist was on the way. The situation was not to be taken lightly, as the officers had to visit his ex-wife’s house multiple times to verify his claim. In doing so, he had essentially dug his own grave. Watch how desperately he is trying to frame his ex-wife. The man had quite a sob story, but whether or not it was real was the ultimate question. A few months later, the man called the officers again, claiming that his ex-wife’s boyfriend had been texting him with threats to kill his kids. This is where the story gets interesting. The man was in serious trouble now, and he didn’t even realise it. But this wasn’t it; the man had some last-minute tricks up his sleeve. The man kept pretending to pass out, so the officers decided to take him to the hospital for real. Here’s what Max Payne had to say about his actions. The man was charged with Misuse of 911, False Report of a Non-existent Crime and Resisting without Violence.

00:00 Fake 911 calls
4:51 Few months later, Tries to frame ex-wife's boyfriend

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
